meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: Claude 会先问清你想改什么,再帮你给 NanoClaw 加新能力或改行为——比如加频道、加集成、改触发规则等,最后告诉你如何重建重启来验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加新频道(Telegram、Slack 等)、加集成、改触发规则或路由等自定义时触发;它会先提问弄清你的需求。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 接成输入频道
say.note: 它会先问接到哪个 agent group、隔离级别

say.text: 给这个 agent group 加一个 Google 日历的 MCP 工具
say.note: 有对应技能就直接调用

say.text: 改一下这个组的性格和指令

howto.what_en: Claude first asks what you want to change, then adds capabilities or modifies NanoClaw behavior — new channels, integrations, trigger rules — and tells you how to rebuild and restart to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add a new channel (Telegram, Slack, etc.), add an integration, change trigger rules or routing, or make other NanoClaw customizations; it asks questions first to clarify the request.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: It first asks which agent group and isolation level

say_en.text: Add a Google Calendar MCP tool to this agent group
say_en.note: It invokes the matching skill if one exists

say_en.text: Change this group's persona and instructions
